results.note: accuracy 90.0% (18/20); misses: Night Shift Allowance proposed EXCL_E vs gold WAGE_OTHER; Retention Bonus (monthly, contractual) proposed EXCL_A vs gold WAGE_OTHER. Misses are kept, not tuned away.
results.proves: Recorded proposals scored against human gold labels. Two deliberate misses are kept: Night Shift Allowance (proposed EXCL_E, gold WAGE_OTHER) and Retention Bonus (proposed EXCL_A, gold WAGE_OTHER). Also asserts every proposal passes validateProposal.

misses.name: Night Shift Allowance
misses.rationale: Paid only for nights actually worked, to compensate for the special conditions of night duty. That reads like a sum entailed by the nature of the employment, clause (e). Confidence moderate because the offer letter lists it among monthly earnings, which points the other way.
misses.note: DELIBERATE MISS. Night allowance is contractual monthly remuneration (OFFER_TPL, Annexure A, C), not reimbursement of an expense; no exclusion (a)-(k) fits. Contestable under the "extra work" limb of Vivekananda Vidyamandir, but s.2(y) wages is wider than PF basic wages.

misses.name: Retention Bonus (monthly, contractual)
misses.rationale: Labelled "bonus" and paid under a separate retention agreement, so it looks like a bonus excluded by clause (a). Confidence is moderate: clause (a) only covers a bonus payable under law that is not part of contract remuneration, and this one is contractual.
misses.note: DELIBERATE MISS. Clause (a) needs a bonus payable under a law AND not part of contract remuneration. OFFER_TPL says the retention bonus "forms part of the monthly remuneration payable under the terms of this letter". The label "bonus" misled the classifier.
